limitations: Production portal schemas were audited directly in Mozambique, Kenya, and Zanzibar on 2026-08-26; governed queries define an analytical row as a complete declared source grain with a numeric requested measure, excluding the collection metadata/schema record plus null or incomplete observations.

The Stage 2.7 production grain verifier confirmed zero duplicate groups for gear_summaries, taxa_summaries, and grid_summaries in all three deployments. monthly_summaries and districts_summaries contain versioned duplicate grain rows in Kenya and Mozambique, so newest-timestamp-then-ObjectId canonicalization is mandatory before analysis.

Portal field/grain evidence is verified at the collection-contract level, but upstream derivation and statistically correct weighting for mean/rate rollups remain unverified until pipeline/source-code reconciliation is completed.
Native-app and pipeline sources remain discovery-only and are not planner-queryable in this catalog version.

Stage 3.3 activates Kenya app.catch_monthly and app.gear_summaries only at their verified BMU source grain; cross-BMU/cross-time reductions of stored mean/rate measures and BMU-to-district joins remain forbidden.

unrestricted.description: Interpret the question first, then select any queryable dataset in the active Peskas country; explicit question filters take precedence.
